name: Measured value chain
reader_question: Where along the value chain does a quantity exist in the evidence, and where is it not measured?
relationship: Ordered stages, each with at most one measured quantity on a shared zero-based scale and one unit.
use_when: The stage sequence is fixed and one quantity is reported at some stages
Missing measurements are themselves part of the message
avoid_when: Stage quantities must reconcile as in, out and loss — use conversion-flow
Stages are on different bases or units — use parallel-basis-panels

data_contract.notes: step strictly ascending in chain order
null draws not measured; zero is a measured zero only
A measured stage drawn in the accent

units: One unit across stages; bars start at zero on one scale. Differences between stages are not losses unless the source says so.

editable: Chevrons, bars and value labels as native shapes and text
not_data_bound: Bar heights are computed from the fixture and are not data-bound; editing a value means resizing the bar and its label

table_alternative: A stage table with the quantity, unit and a measured/not measured flag.
variations: Two measures per stage as paired panels
limitations: One quantity per stage; a second measure needs its own panel
Adjacent stage values are not a conversion: definitions of the stages may differ
Up to eight stages across the slide width

excluded_alternatives.reason: Implies a continuous series and interpolates across unmeasured stages

excluded_alternatives.form: Zero-height bar for a missing stage
excluded_alternatives.reason: A missing measurement is not a measured zero
